metadata.cpuBudgetDefinition: Entire child process, its main thread, native threads and Node workers share the same N-CPU affinity mask.
metadata.gcPolicy: Both engines force main-heap GC and two event-loop turns before each sample; reused Cheerio workers also receive GC requests. Retention workloads collect every checkpoint.
metadata.timedScope: Warm pools include input/result structured clone for Cheerio and JS/native conversion for Rust. Cold initialization includes engine import and pool initialization, excludes fixture generation and child Node startup.
metadata.memoryPolicy: Each engine/workload runs in an isolated child process. Stream and retention samples each get a fresh process. Sampled RSS can miss peaks; processLifetimePeakRssBytes includes engine initialization and earlier samples.
metadata.fixtureDescription: Deterministic generated news/catalog HTML with tables, lists, UTF-8/entities, and XML feeds with CDATA. No downloaded corpus.
